title: ADR 0015: Structured `search_context` result — lossless blocks + per-arm provenance for machine consumers
summary: Adds a structured search_context result exposing typed blocks with blob identity and per-arm scores; a 2026-08-24 amendment notes ADR 0022 superseded the opt-in portion, making structuredContent always present.
notes: Status: Accepted → locked. Dated amendment (2026-08-24) records partial supersession by ADR 0022 of the opt-in `format` behavior; the ADR itself is not marked Superseded.
